segments.speaker: townsfolk_merchant
segments.text: Blood on the planks and carts going over them. Trade's never been squeamish.

segments.speaker: townsfolk_merchant
segments.text: The clan wants salt, of all things. I never thought I'd have goblin custom.

segments.speaker: townsfolk_merchant
segments.text: People are buying blankets. Only blankets. Somebody knows something about this cold.

segments.speaker: townsfolk_merchant
segments.text: Prices are what they are. Don't blame the merchant for the weather.

segments.speaker: townsfolk_merchant
segments.text: Everything here is honest goods. Mostly honest. Ask me about the wool.
